properties.name: Kaş town + Çukurbağ peninsula + Limanağzı
properties.note: Hand-drawn. Principle: include what tourists consider Kaş. Excludes Kalkan, Gökseki (north shore of the bay), inland villages (Çukurbağ village, Pınarbaşı), the Bayındır coast and Meis/Kastellorizo. East and marina edges widened to include near-edge places tourists treat as Kaş (Doria, Can Mocamp, Stone Hill and neighbours).
